description:
Recipes that no longer exist: each is replaced by a file at its own path that NeoForge skips
(``neoforge:never``), so the recipe never loads (RLM-272: Apotheosis's potion charms).

id.description: Lowercase snake_case id; becomes realmforge:<id>. Must equal the file name.
id.title: Id

recipes.description: The recipes to remove, e.g. apotheosis:potion_charm: vanilla's or Apotheosis's (its snapshot), never our own.

items.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

recipes.title: Recipes
